title: Review the team plan each quarter

steps.do: For each role, check again whether an agent can now do the work, using the capability register's dated entries, as a proposed decision for the founder: only a person writes the team plan, because it sets every agent's reach.
Apply the behavioral, financial and relationship test to every contractor and raise any that looks like employment.
Propose any person role the goals need, with its cost at about 1.4 times wages and a recruiting brief, as a decision for the founder.
Update the people record with every change since last quarter.

done_criteria.check: Is every proposed role either decided by the founder or open as a decision with its cost and the agent alternative?
